GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 014.331 (3 Feb 50) GA
(SCAPIN-2082/1)
APO 500
22 October 1951
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
Subject : Immigration Service
1. References, a. Circular 14, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, subject: Control of Entry and Exit of Individuals, Gargo, Aircraft, and Surface Vessels Into and From Japan, 22 October 1951.
b. Memorandum for the Japanese Government, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, AG 014.331 (3 Feb 50) GA, SCAPIN 2082, subject: Immigration Service, 20 February 1950.
2. Effective 1 November 1951, individuals departing Japan permanently will not be required to obtain exit clearance. Reference 1b is amended accordingly.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
C. C. B. WARDEN
Colonel, AGC
Adjutant General.
